headline: Max Healthcare and Apollo Hospitals Surge up to 5% After Macquarie Double Upgrade
summary: Shares of Max Healthcare jumped nearly 5% and Apollo Hospitals gained 4% to a fresh 52-week high after Macquarie issued a double upgrade on both Indian hospital operators.
why: Macquarie's double upgrade spurred significant institutional buying into India's private healthcare hospital operators, which are benefiting from expanding medical capacity.

impacts.name: Max Healthcare
impacts.why: Max Healthcare shares jumped nearly 5% following a Macquarie double upgrade.
